name: 93306 · Bakersfield, CA
findings: ZIP 93306 (Bakersfield) has 111 nonprofit organizations. 38 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 27 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 93306 (Bakersfield) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 93306 (Bakersfield) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 63% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 25 organizations here; 36% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 19 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 19 organizations here; 36% of all organizations here have no identified type.
